Equipment:

Gravity 
 Filter

Sand - 
 Anthracite
Introduction

This document outlines 
the minor maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every three years as 
indicated by Y3 in the title block.

The function of the 
gravity filter is to filter the nile river water which is clarified in the 
clarifier, the effluent flows by gravity to the clear well

Technical Specification for 
Gravity Filter:

The first draft initiated by eng. Tarek Abd 
Elmonem Mahmoud, revised by eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Shaker, approved by eng. Mohamed 
Helmy Habib general director, accepted by eng. Mohamed El-tahawy Mostafa Head 
sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS 4x315MW.

This document certified by eng. 
Afaf Ebrahim Eldib CEPC inspection and quality control head sector MPIS 
Coordinator and reviewed by eng. Nageh Soliman Shoosha .
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc

entire vessel should be inspected
